audit.why: Content states Morgana favoured through 2+ items with Yuumi flipping late, matching the packet levelChart (Morgana x6, Yuumi last row). The packet also flags this as a defect ("53.62% win rate but chart gives Morgana 6/7"), but that pattern is the same late-scaling-enchanter shape already seen on lulu/milio, so it is left as-is per the chart rule rather than guessed at.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side all say "Skill", contradicting content win[] (Morgana,Morgana,Morgana,Morgana,Morgana,Morgana,Yuumi).
audit.why: The two layers disagree on every stage.
audit.corrected: Set full phases[0-5].side to Morgana and phases[6].side to Yuumi, matching content, with grounded why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Dark Binding as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number, and never states that Dark Binding, Black Shield or Soul Shackles cancel Yuumi's Final Chapter channel.
audit.why: Missing-interactions data flags your-channel-punished as applicable and unstated.
audit.corrected: Add the cooldown and the channel-cancel interaction.

audit.why: Morgana is female (champ-gender authority) but the full layer used he/his/him throughout — fixed as part of this proposal.
